notes.title: Update Available Now!
notes.content:
Happy Tuesday Scrappers!

A new update is now available to download for PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe. 

We've been listening to community feedback and working away behind the scenes of Junktown to prepare an assortment of changes to share with you. Here's a quick overview of the latest update:

- Gameplay changes to reduce difficulty whilst playing solo, including:
  - Reduced enemy HP and frequency for solo play
  - Re-balanced challenge completion requirements for solo play
  - S.C.R.A.P will now deposit trash directly into your truck more frequently in solo play
 
- Changes to the network multiplayer UI to make it more convenient when playing online (Adding confirms on quit, remembering party codes etc.)
- Fix for audio being too loud on start up
- The settings menu is now available before the tutorial
- Timeout extended for multiplayer character selection

Thank you as always for your continued support, it really means a lot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42761072/08232afcfc4bb7cf22814eacea05266c6da26f8f.gif[/img]

notes.title: August Community Update ✨
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Thanks for your support in cleaning up the streets of Junktown! It's been really exciting to share PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe with you and we've loved seeing you take to the streets in our clean 'em up brawling adventure. We have a few things to update you on so keep reading for the details!

[u][b]Game Update Incoming[/b][/u]
We've been listening to your feedback and are currently working on an update to make some changes to the single player experience. We'll be making adjustments to difficulty, S.C.R.A.P helper AI and a few other elements that we hope will make cleaning up the streets alone a smoother experience. Thanks for your patience as we finalise the details, we'll let you know as soon as it's available.

[u][b]Player Feedback Form[/b][/u]
We're really grateful for your feedback and if you have anything you'd like to share with us directly, we have a player feedback form [url=https://forms.gle/nnAxeurFzx71PYb26]available here[/url]. Any bug reports or suggestions can be made through this form and provide a quick way to get your feedback directly in front of the whole team here at Q-Games. Thanks for taking the time to share your thoughts, it really helps us to prioritise future updates.

[u][b]PAX West[/b][/u]
Next week we're taking off from Japan and heading to Seattle for our very first PAX West! Join us at our booth to meet the Q-Games team and check out our latest games, including PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe. We hope to see you there!

Thanks again for your support and we'll be back soon with more updates.

Q-Games

notes.title: PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe is OUT NOW!

Welcome to Junktown, Scrappers!

Our crazy party-brawler hybrid is out now and we'd love for you to join us in cleaning up the streets. (Both literally and figuratively...)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42761072/b8c919e62245e378bceea91922e5b8d9b490acb4.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663210/PixelJunk_Scrappers_Deluxe/

If you join us in Junktown today, we hope you have a blast. And please consider leaving us a review! We'd love to hear your feedback and every review helps :) 

We're really excited to have a brand new PixelJunk game available on Steam, so thank you for all your support!

Let's go, Scrappers!

notes.title: Introducing the Scrappers of Junktown!
notes.content:
As we count down to the launch of PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe on Steam next week (!!!), we'd like to take a moment to showcase some characters and weapons you will encounter along the way on your scrapping journey. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663210/PixelJunk_Scrappers_Deluxe/

[b]Let's start with the first character you unlock: Ichiro![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42761072/fe85bb3af366d70a29eb14c29a85067361caee5e.png[/img]

With the dress code being funky robots, Ichiro definitely got the memo. Look at him! He matched the color scheme of his outfit to the logo! How could it get any better than that? Admittedly, the chainsaw, torn sweatshirt, and the grumpy eyes are a little frightening, but we promise he's got a good heart.

[b]Next is without a doubt the coolest guy around (Personal opinion): Tamotsu![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42761072/9643a7d6d8abcc49d49bb97a2f2615952b91a0fd.png[/img]

His face says it all. He's tired, burnt out, and doesn't want to be here. But the work he does is for the benefit of all. Construction is tough and often thankless, so make sure to thank Tamotsu when he hoists all that heavy trash into the truck for you. Also, he wears that cone like a king.

[b]Now on to some of our favourite weapons![/b]

The Shotgun deals AOE damage in the area in front of you, which is super useful for dispersing large crowds of enemy robots. However, it does have limited ammo, so it takes a second to reload once it's used up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42761072/101ccbf197244ae1cb75bd1de9ba89af0f90631d.gif[/img]

The Chainsaw does more damage the longer you shred an enemy with it. Be careful not to get hit from behind!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42761072/f91ca92af35c82a71ea74b5e50c673bdcc4d2794.gif[/img]

The Boxing Gloves are fast, strong and a super quick way to send otabots flying! The knockback they deliver to enemies is incredibly useful when surrounded.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42761072/33c4b33f635ff3b736da9f86678b210b9b691c0a.gif[/img]

PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe comes out next week on July 27th, so make sure to add us to your wishlist to get notified when it's available to play! There'll be more posts like this leading up to the release, so keep your eyes peeled!

Scrappers Team

notes.title: We are Steam Deck Verified! Play early to celebrate!
notes.content:
It’s official; PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe is now Steam Deck Verified!

We’ve been working hard to develop the best possible experience on Deck and we’re thrilled to have received an official Verified rating from Valve. 

[list]
[*] All functionality is accessible when using the default controller configuration
[*] Shows Steam Deck controller icons
[*] In-game interface text is legible on Steam Deck
[*] Default graphics configuration performs well on Steam Deck
[/list]
This means that you can clean up the streets of Junktown on the go and from the comfort of your Steam Deck, wherever you are! 

To celebrate, a demo for PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe is available right now! Head straight to Junktown and experience throwing down with your friends online from the comfort of your Steam Deck.

We’ll have more updates to share with you soon, so watch this space and thanks for your continued support.

notes.title: Announcing PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

PixelJunk is back on Steam! 

We're incredibly excited to announce [b]PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe[/b], which is coming to Steam with support for Steam Deck.  It's been a little while since we self-published a PixelJunk title on PC and we can't wait to share what we've been working on. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42761072/5cb35686e82d1e25d416821753aae1d3303fe6cb.gif[/img]

In PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe, you take on the role of the Scrappers; a team of humanoid trash collectors in a not-so-distant future. The goal is to clean up a city overrun with trash following the end of humanity and collection is only half of the job... Trash means cash in Junktown and rival squads will attempt to interfere and bag the rewards for themselves. This is a beat 'em up that's also a clean 'em up! 

There's online multiplayer for up to 4 people and the option for local co-op too, making for the perfect party-brawler hybrid with a bunch of competitive mini-games for you to check out too.

We've got lots more to share in the coming weeks and look forward to you joining us on the streets of Junktown! You can add PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe to your wishlist now and we'll be back with another update in the very near future,

Let's go Scrappers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663210/
